summary: HF Foods Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement: Joinder and Amendment No. 7 to its credit agreement with JPMorgan, TD Bank, and Fifth Third. The amendment increases revolving commitments from $125M to $140M, refinances existing term loans, and adds $40.1M, resulting in $125M term loans outstanding. Maturities extended to 2031 (revolver) and 2036 (term loans). Wells Fargo exited as lender. This is routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
